newsitem.title: FRANCE: British Midland signs large Airbus order.
newsitem.headline: British Midland signs large Airbus order.

text.p: British Midland has formally committed to buying or leasing 20 Airbus jets by signing a deal for 11 A320s and nine A321s, the aircraft maker said on Monday.
The order, estimated by the industry at $1 billion, is the largest by a British carrier for Airbus and was provisionally announced in April.
Airbus said eight of the single-aisle aircraft had been firmly ordered and 12 would be operated under a lease from International Lease Finance Corporation.
Deliveries will start in the spring of 1998.
The order will both replace old aircraft and provide new capacity for the British airline, Airbus said. The A320s will seat 160 passengers and the A321 will carry up to 196 people.

Airbus Industrie is a consortium made up of French state-owned Aerospatiale, British Aerospace Plc, Daimler-Benz Aerospace, a unit of Daimler-Benz AG, and Construcciones Aeronauticas SA (CASA) of Spain.
